templates.name: 可爱 LINE 风格
templates.description: 经典 LINE 贴纸风格，简洁可爱
templates.basePrompt:
Create LINE-style stickers based on the character in the image. Design should be clean, minimal, and charming with soft colors. Character in chibi (two-head) proportion.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Pure white background (#FFFFFF) only
- Each sticker with distinct pose and expression
- Clear spacing between stickers (minimum 20px)
- Arrange in a clean grid layout
templates.styleDescription: Cute LINE sticker style with soft pastel colors and simple, expressive designs
